    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws *.
    have := P3l Hi0 Hlc Hws Hhead.
    by rewrite nth_cat (leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hij).
  + (* P4: exactly one descent LR *)
    move=> Hi0 Hlc Hws.
    rewrite (hlc_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hlc.
    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws.
    have Hij' : i < mm_pos s by rewrite Hmm.
    have Hfit := window_fits_left Hs_ne Hij'.
    rewrite Hmm (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hfit.
    have Hi1_lt : i.+1 < size sl.
      suff : i + 2 <= size sl by rewrite addn2.
      by apply: leq_trans _ Hfit; rewrite leq_add2l.
    have Hpred_lt : i.-1 < size sl :=
      leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hij.
    have := P4l Hi0 Hlc Hws.
    rewrite /is_descent_seq (prednK Hi0).
    by rewrite !(nth_cat) Hpred_lt Hij Hi1_lt.
  + (* P5: pre-window extremum R *)
    move=> Hi0 Hnlc Hws.
    rewrite (hlc_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hnlc.
    rewrite (wa_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws *.
    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws *.
    have := P5l Hi0 Hnlc Hws.
    by rewrite nth_cat (leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hij).

(* ==== Case size sl < i: recurse on right subtree ==== *)
- set i' := i - size sl - 1.
  have Hi'_eq : i' + size sl + 1 = i.
    by rewrite /i' -subnDA addn1 subnK.
  have [P1r [P2r [P3r [P4r P5r]]]] := IHr' i'.
  have Hij_f : i < size sl = false by rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hji).
  have Heq_f : (i == size sl) = false by apply: gtn_eqF.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  + (* P1 *)
    move=> Hpost.
    rewrite (wa_bridge_right Hmm Hji) (ws_bridge_right Hmm Hji) in Hpost *.
    have Hpost_r : i' + window_size i' sr < size sr.
      suff : i' + window_size i' sr + (size sl + 1)
        < size sr + (size sl + 1)
        by rewrite ltn_add2r.
      rewrite addnAC Hi'_eq -(ws_bridge_right Hmm Hji).
      by rewrite -addnA addnC addnA addn1 -Hsz_s.
    have := P1r Hpost_r.
    set ws' := window_size i' sr.
    have Hnth_eq :
      nth 0 s (i + ws') = nth 0 sr (i' + ws').
      by rewrite /s nth_cat ltnNge;
         have : size sl < i + ws'
           by apply: leq_ltn_trans (leqnn _) (leq_addr ws' _);
              exact: ltnW;
         move=> H; rewrite (ltnW (leq_ltn_trans (ltnW Hji) (leq_addr _ _)));
         rewrite /= nth_drop /i' -subnDA addn1
         [_ + i']addnC subnK //.
    Admitted. (* TODO: finish right subtree case *)

1	(* psi_descent_v2.v — Option A: Structural recursion on mmtree              *)
2	(* Replaces fuel-based strong induction with structural induction on the    *)
3	(* min-max tree, producing O(n) proof terms instead of O(3^n).             *)
4	(*                                                                          *)
5	(* Strategy: The 5 structural properties (tree_props) are proved by         *)
6	(* structural induction on `mmtree nat`. At each `Node l x r`, the         *)
7	(* in-order traversal is `sl ++ x :: sr`, and validity says                *)
8	(* `mm_pos s = size sl`. The cons-unfolding lemmas (window_size_cons etc.) *)
9	(* are applied once per node and hidden behind Opaque bridges.             *)
10	
11	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
12	Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm.
13	
14	Set Implicit Arguments.
15	Unset Strict Implicit.
16	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
17	
18	(* ===== Descent predicate (unchanged) ======================================= *)
19	
20	Definition is_descent_seq (w : seq nat) (k : nat) : bool :=
21	  nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1.
22	
23	Example is_descent_seq_ex :
24	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
25	  [seq k <- iota 0 7 | is_descent_seq w k] = [:: 0; 3; 5].
26	Proof. by []. Qed.
27	
28	(* ===== has_left_child (unchanged from original) ============================ *)
29	
30	Fixpoint has_left_child_fuel (fuel : nat) (i : nat) (s : seq nat) : bool :=
31	  match fuel with
32	  | 0 => false
33	  | fuel'.+1 =>
34	      match s with
35	      | [::] => false
36	      | _ :: _ =>
37	          let j := mm_pos s in
38	          if i < j then has_left_child_fuel fuel' i (take j s)
39	          else if i == j then (0 < j)
40	          else has_left_child_fuel fuel' (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s)
41	      end
42	  end.
43	
44	Definition has_left_child (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
45	  has_left_child_fuel (size w) i w.
46	
47	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_0 : forall fuel s,
48	  has_left_child_fuel fuel 0 s = false.
49	Proof.
50	elim=> [//|fuel IH] [//|a s0].
51	by simpl; case: ifP => Hlt; [apply: IH | case: ifP].
52	Qed.
53	
54	Lemma has_left_child_0 s : has_left_child 0 s = false.
55	Proof. exact: has_left_child_fuel_0. Qed.
56	
57	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_monotone fuel1 fuel2 i s :
58	  size s <= fuel1 -> fuel1 <= fuel2 ->
59	  has_left_child_fuel fuel2 i s = has_left_child_fuel fuel1 i s.
60	Proof.
61	elim: fuel1 fuel2 i s => [| f1 IH] f2 i s Hsz1 Hle.
62	  move: Hsz1; rewrite leqn0 => /nilP ->.
63	  by case: f2 Hle.
64	case: f2 Hle => // f2 Hle.
65	case: s Hsz1 => [// | a s0 Hsz1] /=.
66	set s := a :: s0.
67	have Hj : mm_pos s < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
68	set j := mm_pos s.
69	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
70	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= f1.
71	  rewrite size_take Hj.
72	  by apply: (leq_trans Hj2); rewrite -ltnS.
73	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= f1.
74	  rewrite size_drop.
75	  by apply: (leq_trans (leq_subr _ _)); rewrite -ltnS.
76	have Hle1 : f1 <= f2 by [].
77	case: ifP => _.
78	  by apply: IH.
79	case: ifP => _ //.
80	by apply: IH.
81	Qed.
82	
83	Lemma has_left_child_cons i a s0 :
84	  let s := a :: s0 in
85	  let j := mm_pos s in
86	  has_left_child i s =
87	    if i < j then has_left_child i (take j s)
88	    else if i == j then (0 < j)
89	    else has_left_child (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s).
90	Proof.
91	set s := a :: s0. set j := mm_pos s.
92	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
93	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
94	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= size s0.
95	  by rewrite size_take Hj.
96	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= size s0.
97	  by rewrite size_drop; apply: leq_subr.
98	rewrite /has_left_child /= -/j.
99	case: ifP => _.
100	  abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
101	case: ifP => _ //.
102	abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
103	Qed.
104	
105	Example has_left_child_false :
106	  has_left_child 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = false.
107	Proof. by []. Qed.
108	
109	Example has_left_child_true :
110	  has_left_child 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = true.
111	Proof. by []. Qed.
112	
113	Example rank_shift_interior_order_ex :
114	  let L := [:: 4; 7; 5] in
115	  (nth 0 L 1 > nth 0 L 2) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1 > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 2).
116	Proof. by []. Qed.
117	
118	(* ===== Tree validity ======================================================= *)
119	(* A tree is valid_mm if at each node, the root sits at the mm_pos           *)
120	(* position of the in-order traversal.                                       *)
121	
122	Fixpoint valid_mm (t : mmtree nat) : Prop :=
123	  match t with
124	  | Leaf => True
125	  | Node l x r =>
126	      mm_pos (mmtree_to_seq l ++ x :: mmtree_to_seq r) =
127	        size (mmtree_to_seq l) /\
128	      valid_mm l /\ valid_mm r
129	  end.
130	
131	(* mmtree_of_seq_mm produces valid trees *)
132	Lemma valid_mm_build : forall s, valid_mm (mmtree_of_seq_mm s).
133	Proof.
134	rewrite /mmtree_of_seq_mm.
135	suff H : forall fuel s, size s <= fuel ->
136	  valid_mm (mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel s).
137	  by move=> s; apply: H.
138	elim=> [|fuel IH] s Hsz /=.
139	  by case: s Hsz.
140	case: s Hsz => [//|a s0 Hsz].
141	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
142	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
143	set tl := mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel (take j s).
144	set tr := mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel (drop j.+1 s).
145	have Htl_sz : size (take j s) <= fuel.
146	  rewrite size_take Hj.
147	  by rewrite -ltnS; apply: (leq_trans Hj).
148	have Htr_sz : size (drop j.+1 s) <= fuel.
149	  rewrite size_drop.
150	  have : size s <= fuel.+1 by exact: Hsz.
151	  move: Hj; case: (size s) => // k Hk Hk1.
152	  rewrite subSS.
153	  have H1 : k - j <= k by exact: leq_subr.
154	  apply: leq_trans H1 _.
155	  by rewrite -ltnS.
156	have Htl_eq : mmtree_to_seq tl = take j s
157	  by apply: mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel_correct.
158	have Htr_eq : mmtree_to_seq tr = drop j.+1 s
159	  by apply: mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel_correct.
160	split; [|split].
161	- rewrite Htl_eq Htr_eq.
162	  have -> : take j s ++ nth 0 s j :: drop j.+1 s = s.
163	    by rewrite -[RHS](cat_take_drop j s) (drop_nth 0 Hj).
164	  by rewrite size_take Hj.
165	- exact: IH _ Htl_sz.
166	- exact: IH _ Htr_sz.
167	Qed.
168	#[global] Opaque valid_mm_build.
169	
170	(* ===== Bridge lemmas ======================================================= *)
171	(* Each proved once via cons lemmas, then made Opaque. These are the only    *)
172	(* places where fuel_monotone appears; the structural induction proof        *)
173	(* never touches fuel.                                                       *)
174	
175	Section Bridges.
176	
177	Variables (sl sr : seq nat) (x : nat).
178	Let s := sl ++ x :: sr.
179	
180	Hypothesis Hmm : mm_pos s = size sl.
181	
182	(* -- take/drop simplification under mm_pos -- *)
183	
184	Lemma take_mm_eq : take (size sl) s = sl.
185	Proof. by rewrite /s take_cat ltnn subnn take0 cats0. Qed.
186	
187	Lemma drop_mm_eq : drop (size sl).+1 s = sr.
188	Proof.
189	rewrite /s drop_cat ltnNge leqnSn /=.
190	by rewrite subSn // subnn /= drop0.
191	Qed.
192	
193	(* -- window_size bridge -- *)
194	
195	Lemma ws_bridge_left i :
196	  i < size sl ->
197	  window_size i s = window_size i sl.
198	Proof.
199	move=> Hi.
200	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
201	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
202	rewrite (window_size_cons i a s0).
203	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
204	by rewrite Hi -Hs take_mm_eq.
205	Qed.
206	
207	Lemma ws_bridge_root :
208	  window_size (size sl) s = size s - size sl.
209	Proof.
210	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
211	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
212	rewrite (window_size_cons (size sl) a s0).
213	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
214	by rewrite ltnn eqxx.
215	Qed.
216	
217	Lemma ws_bridge_right i :
218	  size sl < i ->
219	  window_size i s = window_size (i - size sl - 1) sr.
220	Proof.
221	move=> Hi.
222	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
223	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
224	rewrite (window_size_cons i a s0).
225	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
226	rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hi) /= eq_sym (ltn_eqF Hi).
227	congr (window_size _ _).
228	have -> : drop (size sl) s0 = drop (size sl).+1 s by rewrite Hs.
229	exact: drop_mm_eq.
230	Qed.
231	
232	(* -- window_at bridge -- *)
233	
234	Lemma wa_bridge_left i :
235	  i < size sl ->
236	  window_at i s = window_at i sl.
237	Proof.
238	move=> Hi.
239	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
240	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
241	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0).
242	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
243	by rewrite Hi -Hs take_mm_eq.
244	Qed.
245	
246	Lemma wa_bridge_root :
247	  window_at (size sl) s = drop (size sl) s.
248	Proof.
249	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
250	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
251	rewrite (window_at_cons (size sl) a s0).
252	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
253	by rewrite ltnn eqxx.
254	Qed.
255	
256	Lemma wa_bridge_right i :
257	  size sl < i ->
258	  window_at i s = window_at (i - size sl - 1) sr.
259	Proof.
260	move=> Hi.
261	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
262	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
263	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0).
264	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
265	rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hi) /= eq_sym (ltn_eqF Hi).
266	congr (window_at _ _).
267	have -> : drop (size sl) s0 = drop (size sl).+1 s by rewrite Hs.
268	exact: drop_mm_eq.
269	Qed.
270	
271	(* -- has_left_child bridge -- *)
272	
273	Lemma hlc_bridge_left i :
274	  i < size sl ->
275	  has_left_child i s = has_left_child i sl.
276	Proof.
277	move=> Hi.
278	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
279	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
280	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a s0).
281	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
282	by rewrite Hi -Hs take_mm_eq.
283	Qed.
284	
285	Lemma hlc_bridge_root :
286	  has_left_child (size sl) s = (0 < size sl).
287	Proof.
288	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
289	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
290	rewrite (has_left_child_cons (size sl) a s0).
291	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
292	by rewrite ltnn eqxx.
293	Qed.
294	
295	Lemma hlc_bridge_right i :
296	  size sl < i ->
297	  has_left_child i s = has_left_child (i - size sl - 1) sr.
298	Proof.
299	move=> Hi.
300	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
301	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
302	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a s0).
303	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
304	rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hi) /= eq_sym (ltn_eqF Hi).
305	congr (has_left_child _ _).
306	have -> : drop (size sl) s0 = drop (size sl).+1 s by rewrite Hs.
307	exact: drop_mm_eq.
308	Qed.
309	
310	End Bridges.
311	
312	(* Make all bridges opaque to prevent proof-term inlining *)
313	#[global] Opaque ws_bridge_left ws_bridge_root ws_bridge_right.
314	#[global] Opaque wa_bridge_left wa_bridge_root wa_bridge_right.
315	#[global] Opaque hlc_bridge_left hlc_bridge_root hlc_bridge_right.
316	#[global] Opaque take_mm_eq drop_mm_eq.
317	
318	(* ===== Base-case lemmas for i = root ======================================= *)
319	
320	(* These are the non-trivial base cases when i equals the root position.     *)
321	(* They are proved separately and made Opaque to keep the structural         *)
322	(* induction proof's term small.                                             *)
323	
324	Local Lemma pre_win_lt_max_eq
325	  i a s0
326	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
327	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
328	  nth 0 (a :: s0) i.-1 <
329	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0)))
330	          (window_size i (a :: s0)).-1.
331	Proof.
332	subst i.
333	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
334	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
335	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
336	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
337	  move=> Habs;
338	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
339	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
340	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
341	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
342	have Hmax_d := max_val_drop Hs_ne Hno_max Hj.
343	have Hmax_sort := max_eq_nth_sort_last Hdrop_ne.
344	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
345	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
346	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
347	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
348	have Hpred_le :
349	  nth 0 s j.-1 <= foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
350	  by apply: foldr_maxn_ge; apply: mem_nth;
351	     exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
352	have Hpred_ne :
353	  nth 0 s j.-1 != foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
354	  apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
355	  have : foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s)
356	    \in take j s by rewrite -Heq.
357	  by rewrite (negbTE Hno_max).
358	rewrite (window_at_cons j a s0)
359	  (window_size_cons j a s0) -/j ltnn eqxx.
360	rewrite -(size_drop j s) -Hmax_sort Hmax_d.
361	by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hpred_ne Hpred_le.
362	Qed.
363	
364	Local Lemma pre_win_gt_min_eq
365	  i a s0
366	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
367	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
368	  nth 0 (a :: s0) i.-1 >
369	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0))) 0.
370	Proof.
371	subst i.
372	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
373	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
374	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
375	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
376	  move=> Habs;
377	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
378	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
379	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
380	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
381	have Hmin_d := min_val_drop Hs_ne Hno_min Hj.
382	have Hmin_sort := min_eq_nth_sort_0 Hdrop_ne.
383	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
384	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
385	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
386	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
387	have Hpred_ge :
388	  foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
389	    <= nth 0 s j.-1.
390	  by apply: foldr_minn_le; apply: mem_nth;
391	     exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
392	have Hpred_ne :
393	  nth 0 s j.-1 != foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s).
394	  apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
395	  have : foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
396	    \in take j s by rewrite -Heq.
397	  by rewrite (negbTE Hno_min).
398	rewrite (window_at_cons j a s0) -/j ltnn eqxx.
399	rewrite -Hmin_sort Hmin_d.
400	by rewrite ltn_neqAle eq_sym Hpred_ne Hpred_ge.
401	Qed.
402	
403	Local Lemma xone_desc_eq
404	  i a s0
405	  (Huniq : uniq (a :: s0))
406	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
407	  (Hws : 1 < size (a :: s0) - mm_pos (a :: s0))
408	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
409	  is_descent_seq (a :: s0) i.-1 (+)
410	  is_descent_seq (a :: s0) i.
411	Proof.
412	subst i.
413	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
414	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
415	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
416	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
417	  move=> Habs;
418	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
419	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
420	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
421	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
422	have Hnth := nth_w_mm_pos Hs_ne.
423	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
424	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
425	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
426	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
427	have Hj1_lt : j.+1 < size s.
428	  have : j + 2 <= size s
429	    by rewrite -(leq_subRL 2 (ltnW Hj)).
430	  by rewrite addn2.
431	have Hj1_in : nth 0 s j.+1 \in s
432	  by apply: mem_nth.
433	rewrite /is_descent_seq (prednK Hlc).
